description.example: Accepts SKU and quantity; validates stock.

assignedTo.description: Slug of the dev agent that claimed the task.

blocked.description: Task blocked waiting on a decision or a dependency.

blockedOrigin.description: The ORIGIN of the block (ADR 0020/0038), when known. `null` for every Phase 4a block — only the QA Lead (Phase 8b) fills it in.

gateStatus.description: Where the task's PR is in the gate pipeline: QA, then SecOps, then the user. `null` while no PR is open.

gateCorrectionCount.description: How many correction rounds the gates have already requested.

403.description: Service token missing or different from the shared one.

404.description: Session, project, or resource not found.

409.description: Invalid transition, or another agent's task.
